Questions

What do you need for a quote?

Location, number of cabins and opening month. A site plan and utility details help us be precise.

Is the bathroom in the kit price?

The plan has a bathroom space. Fixtures, waterproofing and ventilation are quoted per project.

Can we use another model?

Yes. The factory has 30+ standard designs, including ones with a large terrace. We will match your accommodation format.

Is there a batch discount?

The proposal shows the price of one cabin and of a batch side by side. What changes depends on delivery and shared site works.
